title: Sr/Lead Genai Engineer
description:
Job Expectation 
 Role : Python.AI Engineer Exp : 5 to 12 Years 
 Role Overview 
 We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to design and build production-grade Generative AI solutions with a strong focus on agentic workflows, multi-agent systems, and enterprise AI applications. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and AI agent frameworks. Key Responsibilities Design, architect, and develop scalable Generative AI applications and agentic solutions for real-world business use cases. Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar technologies. Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that power AI-driven products. Implement advanced AI patterns including RAG, Agentic RAG, tool/function calling, planning & reflection loops, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Engineer and optimize prompts, system instructions, and agent workflows to improve reliability, accuracy, and user experience. Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, third-party APIs, vector databases, and knowledge repositories. Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve model and agent performance using observability tools, metrics, and user feedback. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Design teams to deliver impactful AI solutions. Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices, contributing innovative ideas to the team. Document architectures, design decisions, and reusable solution patterns while supporting knowledge sharing across teams. Required Qualifications Must Have 4 -8 years of overall software engineering experience. 3+ years of hands-on experience building applications using Generative AI and LLM technologies. Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing production-ready applications. Hands-on experience with at least two agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Microsoft Copilot extensibility. Strong backend development skills, including REST/gRPC APIs, asynchronous programming, Docker, and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. Solid understanding of leading LLMs including OpenAI GPT models, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and open-source alternatives. Practical experience building RAG solutions using vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Qdrant. Expertise in prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, structured outputs, guardrails, ReAct patterns, and evaluation techniques. Strong problem-solving, system design, and architectural decision-making skills. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams. 
 Please share your resume and details to Vikram_Koteswararao@epam.com

title: Servicenow Architect (All Modules)
description:
ServiceNow All Modules Architect Experience: 515 Years
 Location: Indore
 Interview Mode: Face-to-Face (F2F) – Indore Office
 Interview Date: 26th September 2026 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow All Modules Architect with strong expertise across the ServiceNow platform to design, architect, implement, and govern enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions. The ideal candidate should have broad knowledge across multiple ServiceNow modules, strong hands-on technical expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow architectures. This role requires someone who can work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership to define platform strategy, architecture standards, integrations, and implementation roadmaps. Key Responsibilities Design and define end-to-end ServiceNow architecture across multiple modules. Provide technical leadership for ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, and platform transformations. Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions. Define ServiceNow architecture standards, design patterns, governance, and best practices . Lead solution design across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC and other relevant ServiceNow modules. Design and oversee integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise applications using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, MID Server, APIs, and web services . Review technical designs, configurations, customizations, workflows, scripts, integrations, and data models. Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow best practices and minimize unnecessary customization. Drive platform performance, scalability, security, availability, and maintainability. Provide technical guidance to ServiceNow developers, administrators, and implementation teams. Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, estimations, and solution planning. Define migration, upgrade, release, and deployment strategies. Identify opportunities for automation and platform optimization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of ServiceNow solutions. Troubleshoot complex platform and integration issues and provide architectural recommendations. Mandatory Technical Skills ServiceNow Platform Strong experience in ServiceNow architecture and enterprise implementations . Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules . Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, data model, application architecture, security, and configuration. Hands-on experience with ServiceNow scripting , including:
 JavaScript Glide APIs Business Rules Script Includes Client Scripts UI Policies / UI Actions Scripted REST APIs Strong understanding of Flow Designer, Workflow, IntegrationHub and ServiceNow APIs . ServiceNow Modules Candidates should have strong expertise in multiple modules, preferably including: ITSM – IT Service Management ITOM – IT Operations Management ITAM – IT Asset Management CSM – Customer Service Management HRSD – Human Resources Service Delivery SecOps – Security Operations GRC / IRM – Governance, Risk & Compliance / Integrated Risk Management CMDB Service Portal / Employee Center ServiceNow Discovery Service Mapping Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM/ITBM) Candidates with broader exposure across the ServiceNow ecosystem will be preferred. Integration & Architecture Strong experience designing ServiceNow integrations with enterprise systems . Experience with:
 REST APIs SOAP APIs IntegrationHub MID Server Web Services SSO / SAML / OAuth LDAP / Active Directory Understanding of integration architecture, data synchronization, authentication, and error handling. Experience integrating ServiceNow with cloud platforms, monitoring tools, IT infrastructure, ERP/CRM systems, and other enterprise applications. Additional Preferred Skills ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) . ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) . Relevant CIS certifications across ServiceNow modules. Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications. Experience with ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) is highly desirable. Experience with ServiceNow Now Assist / AI capabilities will be an added advantage. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Experience working with enterprise-scale ServiceNow environments. Soft Skills Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to interact with senior business and technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to lead technical discussions and architecture decisions. Good documentation and presentation skills. Ability to mentor and guide ServiceNow technical teams. Strong ownership and delivery mindset. Experience 5–15 years of overall IT experience , with significant experience in ServiceNow architecture, implementation, development, or consulting. Candidates should demonstrate progression from ServiceNow development/implementation into solution architecture or technical architecture responsibilities . Interview Details Interview Mode: Face-to-Face only
 Interview Location: Indore Office
 Interview Date: 26th September 2026 Candidates must be available to attend the F2F interview at the Indore office on the scheduled date. Ideal Candidate Profile We are particularly looking for candidates who have: 5–15 years of relevant IT experience. Strong ServiceNow architecture experience. Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules , rather than being limited to a single module. Strong hands-on technical understanding. Enterprise integration and API experience. Experience leading ServiceNow solution design and implementation. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills. ServiceNow certifications, especially CIS/CTA , will be an advantage.

Key Skills: Secops,Servicenow,ITSM,Itom,Servicenow Modules,CSM,Architecture

title: Servicenow Gen AI Architect
description:
ServiceNow GenAI Architect Experience: 515 Years

 Interview Mode: Face-to-Face (F2F) – Indore Office
 Interview Date: 26th September 2026 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow GenAI Architect to lead the design, implementation, and adoption of Generative AI capabilities across the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in ServiceNow architecture and GenAI/AI capabilities , with hands-on expertise in Now Assist, AI Search, Virtual Agent, intelligent automation, AI Agents/Agentic AI, Knowledge Management, and ServiceNow integrations . The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, ServiceNow teams, data/AI teams, and enterprise architects to identify AI use cases and deliver secure, scalable, and business-focused GenAI solutions. Key Responsibilities Design and implement Generative AI solutions on the ServiceNow platform . Lead the architecture and implementation of ServiceNow Now Assist and GenAI capabilities . Identify and evaluate business use cases where GenAI can improve service delivery, employee experience, automation, and operational efficiency. Design AI-powered solutions across ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, ITAM, SecOps and GRC/IRM . Implement and optimize Now Assist capabilities for relevant ServiceNow workflows and applications. Design AI-powered experiences using Virtual Agent, AI Search, Knowledge Management and conversational AI . Work with AI Agents / Agentic AI capabilities to automate multi-step enterprise workflows. Integrate ServiceNow with external AI/LLM platforms and enterprise applications where required. Design secure architectures for LLM, GenAI, APIs, enterprise data and ServiceNow integrations . Develop strategies for prompt design, grounding, knowledge retrieval, response quality, and AI governance. Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and responsible-AI standards. Define technical architecture, solution designs, integration patterns, data flows, and implementation roadmaps. Work with ServiceNow developers and AI/ML engineers to translate architecture into production-ready solutions. Evaluate AI-generated responses and improve accuracy, relevance, reliability, and user experience. Establish appropriate guardrails for GenAI applications, including access control, data protection, human oversight, and auditability. Conduct technical feasibility assessments, POCs, and demonstrations for new GenAI capabilities. Monitor and optimize AI solution performance, scalability, cost, and adoption. Stay current with ServiceNow's evolving AI and GenAI capabilities and recommend relevant solutions. AI Architecture & Governance The candidate should understand: Enterprise GenAI architecture AI security and governance Data privacy and access control Prompt and response governance AI observability and monitoring Human-in-the-loop mechanisms Responsible AI principles Model and prompt evaluation Data classification and protection Cost and performance optimization for GenAI applications Preferred Certifications Candidates with the following certifications will be preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator ( CSA ) ServiceNow Certified Application Developer ( CAD ) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist ( CIS ) ServiceNow AI / GenAI-related certifications ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect ( CTA ) – highly desirable Relevant cloud AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Preferred Experience Experience implementing enterprise GenAI use cases . Experience with ServiceNow Now Assist implementations. Experience building AI-powered ServiceNow workflows and automation. Experience with RAG-based enterprise applications. Experience integrating ServiceNow with LLM platforms. Experience with AI Agents / Agentic workflows. Experience conducting GenAI POCs and converting them into production solutions. Experience working with large enterprise ServiceNow environments. Soft Skills Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Strong solution-design and architectural thinking. Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to lead technical discussions and architecture reviews. Strong documentation and presentation skills. Ability to mentor developers and technical teams. Business-oriented approach to identifying practical AI use cases. Experience 5–15 years of overall IT experience , with significant experience in ServiceNow and AI/GenAI technologies . Candidates with a combination of ServiceNow Architect/Developer experience + hands-on GenAI implementation experience will be strongly preferred. Interview Details Interview Mode: Face-to-Face (F2F)
 Interview Location: Indore Office
 Interview Date: 26th September 2026 Candidates must be available to attend the F2F interview at the Indore office on the scheduled date. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should be a ServiceNow + GenAI specialist , not merely a traditional ServiceNow developer. Strong candidates will typically demonstrate: ServiceNow Architecture Now Assist GenAI/LLMs AI Search/Virtual Agent RAG AI Agents/Automation Enterprise Integrations AI Governance
